summary: Gossamer Bio filed an 8-K disclosing a 1-for-80 reverse stock split effective 11:59 p.m. ET on September 10, 2026, following the board's September 9 ratio selection, together with a proportionate reduction in authorized shares. The Charter Amendment was filed with Delaware on September 10, and split-adjusted trading under symbol GOSS with new CUSIP 38341P 201 begins September 11, 2026. No fractional shares are issued; holders receive a round-up to the nearest whole share, applied at the DTC participant level. This is a routine capital-structure action, not a special situation; watch listing-compliance and liquidity effects.
